message: I would like to apply for an override permit for Math 301 because of schedule conflict.
response:
Hello Jordan, thank you for contacting the Student Support Desk. Your request has been logged under ticket reference REQ-004.

Academic advising inquiries and course waiver requests are reviewed by academic department counselors within 24 to 48 business hours. In the meantime, please ensure your prerequisite documentation or course code list is accessible in case your assigned advisor requires supplementary details.

Best regards,
Student Support Desk Triage Team

message: I need advisor approval to enroll in Advanced Algorithms (CS-402) as the prerequisite waiver was submitted last Friday.
response: Hello Maya, your prerequisite waiver verification is currently under departmental review with the Computer Science Advising Committee. Typical review turnaround is 24 to 48 business hours. If approved, an electronic override permit will be attached to your student portal automatically.
